mapper.select: SELECT cr.CAREER_NO AS CAREER_NO , cr.RESUME_NO AS RESUME_NO , cr.JOB_CODE AS JOB_CODE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(cr.START_WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_WORK_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(cr.RETIRE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RETIRE_DATE , cr.TENURE AS TENURE , cr.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT , cr.RESPONSIBILITY AS RESPONSIBILITY , cr.FREELANCER AS FREELANCER , cr.JOB_GRADE_CODE AS JOB_GRADE_CODE , cr.POSITION_CODE AS POSITION_CODE , cr.CAREER_YEAR AS CAREER_YEAR , cr.SALARY AS SALARY , cr.LOCATION AS LOCATION , cr.COM_ID AS COM_ID -- COMPANY 테이블 컬럼 (필요시 JOIN 해주세요) , com.USER_ID AS COM_USER_ID , com.COM_NAME AS COM_NAME , com.COM_INFO AS COM_INFO , com.COM_NUM AS COM_NUM , com.COM_EMAIL AS COM_EMAIL , com.COM_URL AS COM_URL , com.COM_CREATE_YEAR AS COM_CREATE_YEAR , com.COM_MEM AS COM_MEM , com.COM_LOGO AS COM_LOGO , com.COM_PAYMENT AS COM_PAYMENT , com.INDUSTRY_TYPE AS COM_INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM CAREER cr INNER JOIN COMPANY com ON cr.COM_ID = com.USER_ID WHERE cr.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo}

SELECT CAREER_NO , RESUME_NO , JOB_CODE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(START_WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_WORK_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(RETIRE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RETIRE_DATE , TENURE , DEPARTMENT , RESPONSIBILITY , FREELANCER , JOB_GRADE_CODE , POSITION_CODE , CAREER_YEAR , SALARY , LOCATION , COM_ID FROM CAREER WHERE CAREER_NO = #{careerNo}

SELECT C.CAREER_NO , C.RESUME_NO , C.JOB_CODE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(C.START_WORK_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_WORK_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(C.RETIRE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RETIRE_DATE , C.TENURE , C.DEPARTMENT , C.RESPONSIBILITY , C.FREELANCER , C.JOB_GRADE_CODE , C.POSITION_CODE , C.CAREER_YEAR , C.SALARY , C.LOCATION , C.COM_ID , CO.COM_NAME AS COM_NAME FROM CAREER C LEFT JOIN COMPANY CO ON C.COM_ID = CO.USER_ID WHERE C.CAREER_NO = #{careerNo}
